_note: Editable starter reference keywords per role. These are illustrative, not definitive hiring requirements. Keyword names must match a 'name' in skill_keywords.json.

data_analyst.title: Data Analyst
data_analyst.description: Collects, cleans and analyses data, and communicates insights through reports and dashboards.

SQL.title: Add SQL skill
SQL.text: If you have used SQL (queries, joins, aggregations), list it in your skills and mention it in a project or experience bullet.

Excel.title: Mention Excel proficiency
Excel.text: If you use Excel (pivot tables, lookups, charts), list it explicitly; many analyst job descriptions search for it.

group_tips.title: Mention BI / visualization tools
group_tips.text: Neither Power BI nor Tableau was detected. If you have built dashboards with a BI tool, name it and describe one dashboard you built.

project_tips.title: Show SQL in a project
project_tips.text: SQL appears in your resume but not in your projects. If a project used SQL, say what you queried or modelled.

web_developer.title: Web Developer
web_developer.description: Builds and maintains websites and web applications across the frontend and backend.

SQL.title: Add SQL skill
SQL.text: If you have worked with a relational database, list SQL (and the database, e.g. MySQL/PostgreSQL) in your skills.

React.title: Include React projects
React.text: React is a commonly requested frontend library. If you have built anything with React, add it as a project with a short description and link.

Git.title: Mention Git / version control
Git.text: If you use Git and GitHub, list Git in your skills and link your GitHub profile.

REST API.title: Mention REST API work
REST API.text: If you have built or consumed REST APIs, describe that in a project (e.g. 'Built a REST API with Node.js and Express').

project_tips.title: Include React projects
project_tips.text: React is listed in your skills but no React project was detected. If you have one, describe it in your Projects section.

ai_engineer.title: AI Engineer
ai_engineer.description: Designs, trains, evaluates and integrates machine learning models into applications.

Model Evaluation.title: Describe model evaluation
Model Evaluation.text: Mention how you evaluated models (accuracy, F1-score, cross-validation) and the results you achieved.

Data Preprocessing.title: Mention data preprocessing
Data Preprocessing.text: If you cleaned data or engineered features before training, say so explicitly in your project descriptions.

API Integration.title: Mention model deployment / API integration
API Integration.text: If you exposed a model through an API (Flask, FastAPI) or integrated an AI API, describe it in a project.

group_tips.title: Mention an ML framework
group_tips.text: No ML framework (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) was detected. If you have used one, name it in your skills and projects.

cloud_engineer.title: Cloud Engineer
cloud_engineer.description: Designs, deploys and operates infrastructure and applications on cloud platforms.

Docker.title: Mention containerization
Docker.text: If you have containerised an application with Docker, list Docker in your skills and describe it in a project.

CI/CD.title: Mention CI/CD pipelines
CI/CD.text: If you have set up automated build/deploy pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), describe one.

Linux.title: Mention Linux skills
Linux.text: If you are comfortable with Linux administration or shell scripting, list it explicitly.

group_tips.title: Mention cloud technologies
group_tips.text: No cloud platform was detected. If you have used AWS, Azure or Google Cloud (even in labs or free-tier projects), name the platform and services.
